description: Drug shortages batch (up to 15 drugs) — Check up to 15 drugs against the FDA drug shortage list in one call. Pass ?drugs= generic or brand names separated by commas and optional ?status=current (default) | resolved | discontinued | all. Returns which drugs are in shortage, which are clear, and the affected products with availability and last update. Price: $0.02 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: fda_shortages_batch
